mechanism: Armodafinil may increase blood pressure and heart rate through sympathomimetic effects, potentially opposing the antihypertensive action of enalapril (ACE inhibitor), while enalapril metabolites may undergo CYP3A4-mediated metabolism where armodafinil is a mild inducer.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; armodafinil may reduce enalapril efficacy, requiring dose adjustment or consideration of alternative agents if hypertension control becomes inadequate.
